summary: Created Redux state structure for SMS message management. Installed @reduxjs/toolkit and react-redux. Created sms.types.js with MessageStatus enum and JSDoc type definitions. Created smsSlice.js with messages/loading/error state, reducers (addMessage, updateMessageStatus, removeMessage, setLoading, setError), and selectors (selectAllMessages, selectMessageById, selectPendingMessages, selectMessagesByStatus). Configured Redux store in store/index.js and wrapped App with Provider in main.jsx.
